description:
AEF - The Avalon Expedition
Unofficial English translation of the mod by MAJOR_Kai

An anomalous dimensional resonance has thrown an Avali exploration fleet out to the edge of the Persean Sector.

Download (GitHub)

Mod version: 0.6.9-2  |  Game version: 0.98.5a-RC4
Requires: nothing  |  Optional: Nexerelin, MagicLib, Kalian
Original (Chinese) thread

What is this?
AEF adds the Avali, a nomadic fleet of explorers, as a new faction with its own modular ships, a heat-management weapon system, drones and fighters, campaign content and missions. This release is a complete English translation covering ships, weapons, hullmods, systems, descriptions, dialogue, mission briefings, tips and campaign text.

Fleet gallery

Highlights

New faction and system: the AEF arrives at the edge of the sector. Earn their trust and reputation, and use the Call Supply Drop ability near an Avali Waystation.
Modular ships: hullmods that reconfigure hangars, armor, engines and side modules.
Heat system: thermal weapons build heat on your ship, and running hot brings escalating overheat penalties. Safety Overrides shifts the thresholds.
Drones and fighters: coordinator, shield and support drones, plus station-based support.
Industries and items: Avali-specific structures, blueprint packs and special installable items.
Nexerelin ground battles: new Avali ground units and fighter support for ground operations (details below), plus an AEF start option.
Missions: story missions with full briefings.

Installation

Extract into your Starsector mods folder and enable it in the launcher.
Updating: delete the old version first; do not overwrite.
Warning: start a new campaign. Adding or removing the mod mid-save is not supported.

Ground battles (requires Nexerelin)

Drone Support Unit: excellent damage in complex terrain and cheap to field, but extremely fragile. Best backed by other friendly units on the line.
M.E.C. Unit: less firepower than heavy-weapons units, but tougher, better in close quarters, and operable by a single soldier.
Avali Frontline Troops (AI only): better survivability and close-quarters ability than marines. Defend Avali worlds and settlements.
Aerospace Fighter Support (ability): strikes a random unit at the target facility, scaled by the number of sorties flown. Each fighter in your fleet spends 3 sorties per supply/turn. Friendly target: restores 10% morale and completes reorganization instantly. Enemy target: deals 5 damage and removes its defensive bonuses.

Ground unit cards
Stats shown, left to right and top to bottom: Strength, Cramped-terrain multiplier, Damage taken, Offensive multiplier, Drop cost, Unit size.

About this translation
Updated for 0.98.5a-RC4. Beyond translating the text, this build received a consistency pass: unified ship, system and structure names, restored standard names on the vanilla industries the mod overrides, and corrected tooltips and tips.

AI usage
This translation was made with AI assistance (Claude), used for the initial translation, the 0.98.5a update, and the consistency pass over names, tooltips and tips. I reviewed the results and tested them in-game. If anything reads like a machine translation, please report it and I'll fix it.

Spotted a mistranslation, clipped tooltip or typo? Reply here with where you saw it and I'll fix it. Non-translation gameplay bugs belong with the original author.

Credits

Original mod: MAJOR_Kai
Proofreading and testing: Ranuno
Art and writing: Cross star
English translation: MrPossible
Music: AEF market music from the Hacknet: Labyrinths OST; AEF fleet-contact music by Waterflame

Permission and license
Published with the original author's permission: MAJOR_Kai confirmed that translated versions in any language may be published as long as the license is followed (source, 2026-10-24).

The original license applies: no commercial use or profit in any form; no unauthorized modified versions (minor compatibility or bug-fix tweaks excepted); verbatim redistribution allowed; private modification unrestricted. Please link to this thread instead of re-uploading, so the latest version stays easy to find.
